title: No Prob Bob — Customer Discovery Agent
one_liner: A conversational AI agent that guides customer discovery interviews, extracts insights, and saves structured seed documents to Afterburner projects.
what_it_is: No Prob Bob is a Python-based conversational AI bot designed to facilitate customer discovery. It uses personality frameworks to ask probing questions rather than jumping to solutions, supporting text chat, push-to-talk voice interaction (STT/TTS), and Google Sign-In. It integrates with the Afterburner ecosystem to save structured insights.
how_its_built: Built with Python 3.11+, it uses Ollama (default qwen3:4b) or cloud LLMs (Claude/OpenAI) for inference. Voice features rely on Faster-Whisper for STT and Piper-TTS for audio synthesis. Authentication is handled via Google OAuth JWT verification. The server runs on a custom HTTP gateway with SQLite for session management.
how_to_apply: Use this bot during the early stages of product development to validate problem statements. Engage it in simulated or real customer interviews to extract structured insights, which are then saved as seed documents for your project's memory index.
quickstart:
ollama pull qwen3:4b
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/bot-customerObsessed-No-Prob-Bob-afterburner.git
cd bot-customerObsessed-No-Prob-Bob-afterburner
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
pip install "piper-tts>=1.4" "faster-whisper>=1.0" "numpy>=1.24" "scipy>=1.11" "google-auth[requests]>=2.20"
cp .env.example .env
python3 -m bot.server
features: Guides customer discovery interviews with a specific personality framework
Supports push-to-talk voice input and text-to-speech audio responses
Integrates with Google Sign-In for secure user authentication
Saves structured seed documents to Afterburner projects
Runs locally with Ollama for privacy or connects to Claude/OpenAI
Includes a production launcher with watchdog and auto-restart capabilities
